pieces.Text: Once per day, without spending an action, you can sublimate all of your negative thoughts into the spirit to clear your mind in response to gaining one of the following conditions: dazed, frightened, panicked, shaken, staggered, and stunned. You ignore the effects of that particular instance of that condition for

minutes (if you suffer from that condition from another source, it applies normally). This time still counts against the condition's duration. Once the duration expires, the possessing spirit gains 1 point of influence over you.
